definitions.explanation: A person's social standing as determined by the family they were born into. Often refers to the distinction or prestige of one's family background.

examples.japanese: {門地|もんち}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Discrimination based on family status is not permitted.

examples.japanese: {日本国|にほんこく}⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{門地|もんち}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}している→禁止する：22145_kinshisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese Constitution prohibits discrimination based on family lineage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{門地|もんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だった。
examples.english: In the past, it was important to be born into a family of high pedigree.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (gate, family) + {地|ち} (status, ground). Literally "the ground on which the family gate stands," referring to the social standing inherited through birth.

LEGAL CONTEXT:
This word appears in Article 14 of the Japanese Constitution, which guarantees equality: ⟦{人種|じんしゅ}→人種：03354_jinshu⟧、⟦{信条|しんじょう}→信条：10451_shinjou⟧、⟦{性別|せいべつ}→性別：04346_seibetsu⟧、⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧{又|また}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{門地|もんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧...⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧ ("shall not be discriminated against on the basis of race, creed, sex, social status, or family origin").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門地|もんち}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧: discrimination based on lineage
- {門地|もんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: of high pedigree
- {門地|もんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of family background

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家柄|いえがら}→家柄：16695_iegara⟧: family lineage, pedigree — more commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧: social status, standing — broader than family background alone
- ⟦{血統|けっとう}→血統：14027_kettou⟧: bloodline, lineage — emphasizes genetic descent
